pr_title: drivers/sensor/lsm6dsl: Fix read/write bus API in shub code
pr_body:
The ce0cc3a7 commit (lsm6dsl: make the driver multi-instance) changes
all bus API signature, which now requires a "const struct device *dev"
and not a "struct lsm6dsl_data *data". By mistake the shub part was
left unchanged. Fix: #28565

Not tested yet!
I just built it and verified it is compiling properly.
I would like to test it on x_nucleo_iks01a2 shield, but I require to extend the current available
sample. For the moment just take a look at it and see if I have done any mistake.

For the moment it is a DNM. I do not think the shub will have any problem. So, we may want to
skip the test if v2.4.0 has to be released soon.

EDIT:
Removed the DNM!
Tested on x_nucleo_iks01a2 shield in shub mode. Tested both LIS2MDL and LPS22HB sensors connected in shub mode.
The shield and sample changes will be provided in a separated commit as some documentation change is required.

issue_context.title: sensor: lsm6dsl: incompatible pointer type (warning)
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Warnings generated when building sensor lsm6dsl.
```
lsm6dsl_shub.c: In function 'lsm6dsl_shub_embedded_en':
lsm6dsl_shub.c:160:26: error: passing argument 1 of 'data->hw_tf->update_reg' from incompatible pointer type [-Werror=incompatible-pointer-types]
  160 |  data->hw_tf->update_reg(data, LSM6DSL_REG_FUNC_CFG_ACCESS,
      |                          ^~~~
      |                          |
      |                          struct lsm6dsl_data *
lsm6dsl_shub.c:160:26: note: expected 'const struct device *' but argument is of type 'struct lsm6dsl_data *'

```

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. sanitycheck -b 96b_argonkey -T samples/sensor/lsm6dsl (or -T samples/boards/96b_argonkey/sensors)
2. See error

**Expected behavior**
Should build w/o warning

review_comments: No, sorry! Actually it is required.
Ah, yes, I see its use now.
